task.title: Vibe Agent misclassifies prompts via substring matching ("workout" -> "work"), returns literal "unknown" search queries, and lacks negation/input sanitization
task.body:
> **Fixed by:** #208 ([commit `37611da`](https://github.com/simonepelosi/vibez/commit/37611daf9827472d93c7c69a294bb94497dadfdb))

## Summary

[`internal/vibe/agent.go`](https://github.com/simonepelosi/vibez/blob/29ddbc232f45b5f8a695e91c7574955b88a0ff98/internal/vibe/agent.go) contains several classification, query-generation, and input-hardening bugs in `KeywordAgent`:

1. **Substring keyword matching causes systematic false positives**: [`KeywordAgent.Parse`](https://github.com/simonepelosi/vibez/blob/29ddbc232f45b5f8a695e91c7574955b88a0ff98/internal/vibe/agent.go#L117-L148) tests `strings.Contains(lower, kw)` without word-boundary checks and returns on the first matching rule:
   - `"workout"` matches `"work"` in `focused` before reaching `aggressive` (`gym`).
   - Unrelated words (`"uneasy"`, `"grunge"`, `"chocolate"`, `"transmission"`, `"lemon"`, `"network"`, `"mandate"`) trigger arbitrary short substring rules (`"easy"`, `"run"`, `"late"`, `"ran"`, `"emo"`, `"work"`, `"date"`).
2. **Negated keywords still trigger the negated mood**: Prompts like `"not sad, party!"`, `"no chill, gym"`, or `"don't want sad songs, hype"` ignore negation tokens (`not`, `no`, `without`, `never`, `don't`, `n't`).
3. **`ToSearchQuery` returns the literal search string `"unknown"` on fallback**: [`KeywordAgent.ToSearchQuery`](https://github.com/simonepelosi/vibez/blob/29ddbc232f45b5f8a695e91c7574955b88a0ff98/internal/vibe/agent.go#L150-L157) returns `v.Mood` (`"unknown"`) when `Genres` is empty, searching Apple Music for tracks literally named `"unknown"` instead of using the user's sanitized prompt.
4. **`morning` vs `party` rule collision in `ToSearchQueries`**: [`KeywordAgent.ToSearchQueries`](https://github.com/simonepelosi/vibez/blob/29ddbc232f45b5f8a695e91c7574955b88a0ff98/internal/vibe/agent.go#L159-L195) checks `mood + genres[0]` (`"upbeat"` + `"pop"`), routing `"morning coffee"` into EDM/club party bangers instead of morning queries.
5. **Shared rule slice aliasing & unsanitized untrusted input**: Returning rule table `Genres` slices directly exposes package-level slices to caller mutation, and `Parse` accepts unsanitized ANSI/C0/C1/BiDi or oversized inputs.

## Affected Code (`main`)

- [`KeywordAgent.Parse`](https://github.com/simonepelosi/vibez/blob/29ddbc232f45b5f8a695e91c7574955b88a0ff98/internal/vibe/agent.go#L117-L148)
- [`KeywordAgent.ToSearchQuery`](https://github.com/simonepelosi/vibez/blob/29ddbc232f45b5f8a695e91c7574955b88a0ff98/internal/vibe/agent.go#L150-L157)
- [`KeywordAgent.ToSearchQueries`](https://github.com/simonepelosi/vibez/blob/29ddbc232f45b5f8a695e91c7574955b88a0ff98/internal/vibe/agent.go#L159-L195)

## Resolution (#208)

- Replace substring first-match with linear-time ($O(N)$, ReDoS-free) clause-aware token & multi-word phrase scoring and clause-scoped negation handling.
- Return sanitized `v.Query` / `v.Keywords` instead of `"unknown"` in `ToSearchQuery`, disambiguate `morning` vs `party` in `ToSearchQueries`, and `slices.Clone` returned `Genres` / `Keywords` slices.
- Cap raw bytes (`512`) and runes (`256`) and strip ANSI escapes, C0/C1/DEL controls, invalid UTF-8, and Unicode BiDi override/isolate runes.

## Related Audit Issues & PRs

|------|-------|--------------|
| Apple Music Provider | #210 | #206 |
| TUI UTF-8, Paste & Sanitization | #211 | #207 |
| Vibe Agent Word-Boundary & Negation | #212 *(this issue)* | #208 |
| Browserless Lifecycle, UAF & CDM Hardening | #213 | #214 |
